boot-start-marker
boot-end-marker
hostname r-cisco
no ip domain lookup
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.1.1 255.255.255.0
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.0.1.254
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh

hostname r-eos
transceiver qsfp default-mode 4x10G
mlag configuration
   domain-id leaf

ip routing
interface Ethernet1
   no switchport
   ip address 10.0.3.1/30
management api http-commands
   no shutdown
